purpose: Independent quality-gate candidate selection for ORS relational parsing. These chapters are outside the fixed development sample and are selected from authoritative published ORS structure, not from parser output.
selectionPolicy: Choose a small cross-section that spans ordinary numeric chapters, very large chapters, administrative-law structure, heavily regulated subject matter, and a lettered chapter with published pending-change notices. Do not change the selection in response to parser results.

chapters.rationale: Ordinary numeric chapter with operative sections, repealed stubs, subdivisions and temporary-note material.
Very large civil-property chapter selected to stress section enumeration without reusing a development chapter.
Administrative procedure chapter with dense cross-references and long source histories.
Large regulatory chapter with many subdivisions and section histories.
Lettered chapter outside the development sample; current publication also carries explicit 2026 pending-change notices above the 2025 edition text.
